Description
Overview
Computer-controlled hydraulic universal testing machines UH-X and UH-FX Series with front-opening hydraulic grips. Suitable for tensile, compression and bending tests across approximately 400–2000 kN capacity. Stress control and strain control modes comply with ISO 6892; UH-Xh and UH-FXh models offer a hybrid hydraulic oil source that reduces oil volume and significantly lowers electrical power consumption (approx. 50 %; example UH-500kNXh up to 82 %). Large color touchscreen and operator-oriented controls improve visibility and handling.
Key features
Semi-Auto-Tuning: automatic adjustment of control parameters for high-precision stress and strain control (ISO 6892-2009, JIS Z2241).
Extra-large color LCD touch-screen for improved operability and visibility.
Rangeless data measurement and ultra-high-speed sampling to capture sudden strength changes.
Front-opening type hydraulic grips for easier specimen handling.
USB memory enables performing tests without a PC; key switch included as standard.
Optional crosshead elevating switch box for fingertip control.
Hybrid hydraulic unit reduces hydraulic oil quantity and energy consumption (e.g. UH-500kNXh up to 82%); quieter hydraulic unit available for UH-FX models.
Multiple automatic control programs included as standard.

Applications
Tensile, compression and bending tests of metallic and composite materials; static, cyclic and custom test sequences for R&D, QA and production control. Example document: Tensile Test of Steel for the Reinforcement of Concrete (PDF, 338.97KB) — 2020-10-27.
Technical specifications
Machine type: Computer-controlled hydraulic servo universal testing machine (UH-X) and high-performance hydraulic universal testing machine (UH-FX).
Force range: approximately 400 kN to 2000 kN (model-dependent).
Control modes: Stress control and strain control (ISO 6892 compliant); Semi-Auto-Tuning for automatic parameter adjustment.
Grips: Front-opening type hydraulic grips for improved accessibility.
Display & operation: Extra-large color LCD touch-screen; USB memory support for standalone testing; key switch standard.
Data & sampling: Rangeless data measurement; ultra-high-speed sampling to capture sudden variations.
Hydraulics & energy: UH-Xh/UH-FXh hybrid hydraulic oil source reduces oil volume and power consumption (approx. 50 % typical; up to 82 % for UH-500kNXh example); quieter unit available for UH-FX.
Options & software: Optional crosshead elevating switch box; multiple automatic control programs; optional PC software (Trapezium X) for advanced test sequences and data logging.
Standards: Compliant with ISO 6892-2009, JIS Z2241 and other common tensile/compression standards.
